name: Blu Label Unlimited Group Limited
summary: Blu Label Unlimited Group Limited provides prepaid products and distributes virtual electronic merchandise in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Africa Distribution, International, and Solutions segments. The company provides voucher or PIN-based airtime, and PIN-less or direct top-up airtime; UniPIN, a PIN-based prepaid electricity voucher; and other various electronic vouchers for mobile services and water, as well as distributes prepaid SIM cards, and mobile devices and accessories. It also provides Cellfind messaging portals, financial services, and location-based services; hardware offerings include POS terminals, vending machines, and bulk vouchers; media advertising…
